description.value: Shanghai City Restaurant has been a Nanaimo institution since 1999, serving over 110 Chinese dishes spanning Szechuan, seafood, chow mein, and dim sum traditions. It claims the largest buffet in Nanaimo and is particularly noted for its traditional weekend dim sum lunch service. Takeout, delivery, and a buffet-to-go option make it a practical fuel stop for cyclists moving through the Island Highway corridor.
